identity.title: [C-SDLC v2][GitHub] Classify missing issue reads with actionable repository/404 diagnostics

values.task_boundary: Add a bounded issue-read failure taxonomy and safe diagnostic mapper plus focused real-CLI loopback proof; do not redesign other GitHub operations.
deliverables: Stable issue-read remote failure codes and exit mapping
Exact JSON, exit-code, stdout/stderr, and secret-redaction assertions
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: HTTP 404 issue reads return remote_not_found with exit 69 and say owner/name#N was not found or is inaccessible, directing the operator to verify repository, issue number, and token access
AC-2: HTTP 401 and ordinary HTTP 403 are typed as authentication or authorization failures and never as not-found
AC-3: HTTP 429 and only the design's closed allowlist of primary or secondary rate-limit HTTP 403 markers are typed as rate-limited; near-match and ordinary HTTP 403 remain authorization
AC-4: HTTP 5xx and connection failures are typed as server or transport failures and never as not-found
AC-5: Successful issue-read request/result JSON and all non-read action readback failure behavior remain unchanged
AC-6: Failure stdout is valid csdlc.error.v1 JSON, exit codes are stable, and stderr remains empty unless stdout writing fails
AC-7: Token value, token path, authorization material, sensitive response-body sentinel, and raw Octocrab error text are absent from stdout and stderr
AC-8: Focused real-binary loopback tests and strict Clippy pass with no unresolved review findings
dependencies: Existing csdlc.error.v1 serialization and ErrorCode exit mapping
non_goals: Issue creation, update, comment, or close semantic changes
Broad GitHub client or retry refactoring
